title: objectql: the security-catalog name-conflict refusals still say a permission set holds one name per deployment
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5mswnWm181XgYcCUag

Out-of-scope finding of #32758 (PR #33384, dev report 6882046858), class b, release text.

`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`: the `SecurityCatalogNameConflictError` hot-install message (about `:2878-2882` on `main`) and `coldBootConflictMessage` (about `:2818`) both say "Positions, permission sets and capabilities each hold one name per deployment: an assignment names a position or a permission set by its bare name". Since PR #32742 a grant carries `permission_set_package` and two namespaces may hold one permission-set name. The refusals themselves still fire only where `permissionSetHoldersMeet` says the holders meet, so only the sentence is wrong.

**TO:** say positions and capabilities hold one name per deployment, and a permission set one name per namespace (co-owners of one namespace, a package with no namespace, the platform namespaces and `guest_portal` keep one holder), matching the describe and docs #33384 lands. Update any test that pins the old sentence.

No rule change. `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none`; `@objectstack/objectql` patch.

class: b · type: Docs · Grade: p3 (shipped refusal text, refusal itself correct) · domain: server
